Acme Widgets raises full-year guidance after record orders

By Jane Reporter

Acme Widgets Plc raised its full-year revenue guidance on Monday after a record first half, saying orders from industrial customers rose 18% to £412m.

The company now expects revenue of £1.2bn to £1.25bn for the year, up from a previous range of £1.1bn to £1.15bn. Adjusted EBITDA margin is expected to expand by around 60 basis points.

Chief executive Sam Example said demand in North America remained strong and that the group would open a second plant in Ohio next year to add capacity.

The board also declared an interim dividend of 4.2p per share, payable in January, and confirmed the £50m buyback programme announced in March.
